title: Jump Game II
statement_short: Given a 0-indexed array of non-negative integers nums where nums[i] represents your max jump length at index i, return the minimum number of jumps required to reach the last index.
hint: Input size up to 10^4 requires O(n) time, reachable by updating jump range boundaries greedily.
keywords: max jump length at index i
why_not: Right: Greedy tracks current jump range end and furthest reachable index to increment jump count in O(n) time and O(1) space. Not 1D DP: DP computing min jumps to each index takes O(n^2) time in the worst case. Not Graph DFS: DFS explores all paths to the end, resulting in exponential search overhead. Not Binary Search: Jump boundaries are non-monotonic, so binary search cannot find min jumps directly.
